_comment: M28.3.3 add_dynamic_cast_node post-apply inspection + soak. Duplicates BP_BpxTestGraphNodesCalls into a scratch path and spawns a UK2Node_DynamicCast targeting /Script/Engine.Actor onto the default EventGraph at a fixed position. Engine.Actor is ubiquitous in all engines; the BP's own class IS an Actor so the cast is well-formed. The inspect gate asserts the rendered .deep.md surfaces the new DynamicCast node AND the typed As<Actor> output pin (proving TargetType was set BEFORE AllocateDefaultPins — post-alloc assignment would leave As<X> as a wildcard). The soak gate asserts md5 stability across 2 rounds, proving SeedGuidFromJoined(':graph:EventGraph:cast:/Script/Engine.Actor:288,-48') + SeedPinGuidsForNode overrides UEdGraphNode::CreateNewGuid + UEdGraphPin::CreatePin's FGuid::NewGuid() calls that fire inside CreatePinsForCastNode.
